landingContent.heroTagline: FORGING THE FUTURE OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
landingContent.heroSubtext: Dayananda Sagar University's premier innovation ecosystem uniting engineers, designers, researchers, and student founders in artificial intelligence.
landingContent.heroDepartment: School of Engineering • Department of AI & Robotics • DSU Bengaluru
landingContent.aboutHeading: AI Foundry is the go-to spot for student creators at Dayananda Sagar University. We turn cool campus ideas into real-world tech by giving you the right mentors, beastly GPU power, and a local community that helps you grow. It's where the future of AI hits the road.
landingContent.aboutSecondaryText: Whether you're fine-tuning custom LLMs, building autonomous agents, designing slick interfaces, or pitching your first venture, you won't be doing it alone. From late-night hackathons and hands-on build sprints to demo days in front of industry veterans, we give you the launchpad to stop just talking about AI and start shipping it.
landingContent.approachSubtext: We foster a dynamic environment where students can transform their ideas into impactful AI and entrepreneurial ventures.

approach.title: Ideation & Problem Discovery
approach.description: We guide members from initial concepts to well-defined project proposals, encouraging creative problem-solving and patent exploration.

approach.title: Prototyping & GPU Compute
approach.description: Providing high-performance compute clusters, research lab access, and technical mentorship for rapid iteration.

approach.title: Venture Incubation & Launch
approach.description: Supporting student founders through legal incorporation, pitch deck polish, and demo day showcases to seed investors.

approach.title: Community & Knowledge Transfer
approach.description: Building an enduring alumni and mentor network, hosting weekly paper reading groups, and sharing open-source code.

landingContent.pillarsSubtext: Our approach to innovation is built on three core strategies.

pillars.title: Innovation
pillars.description: We encourage groundbreaking ideas and provide GPU compute, lab access, and development toolkits for members to explore the frontiers of AI.

pillars.title: Collaboration
pillars.description: We believe in the power of diverse minds working together, fostering a supportive cross-disciplinary environment for peer learning and growth.

pillars.title: Impact
pillars.description: Our projects aim to solve real-world problems, making a tangible difference across healthcare, robotics, education, and venture incubation.

process.title: Idea Generation
process.desc: Brainstorming and refining concepts within our collaborative workshops and 24-hour hackathons.

process.title: Team Formation
process.desc: Connecting students with complementary technical and design skills to form interdisciplinary squads.

process.title: Project Incubation
process.desc: Providing GPU compute, mentorship, and a supportive environment for full-stack prototype development.

process.title: Showcase & Launch
process.desc: Presenting completed projects to the tech community, investors, and supporting venture deployment.

landingContent.teamDescription: Visionary faculty advisors and dedicated student executives guiding innovation, technical excellence, and community initiatives.
